summary: Iteration 28 - Full testing of the new 4-step service creation stepper (packages model). Backend 16/16 PASS. Frontend e2e flow fully working. POST /api/services with packages correctly stores packages + slots. All 4 steps validated: Step1 (title/desc/validation), Step2 (multi-select packages), Step3 (price/duration/WeekCalendar), Step4 (score 85/100, Publier). Submit redirects to profile after API call.

minor.issue: Does not filter by active=TRUE - soft-deleted services still appear (inherited from iteration 27)

ui_bugs.issue: CONSOLE error: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' - caused by React Fragment <><Ionicons/><Text/></> inside TouchableOpacity on web. Non-breaking warning.

issues: No direct 'Créer un service' link on the main profile tab. Coach must go: Profile → Edit Profile → scroll to 'Mes Services' section → click '+ Créer'. Not immediately discoverable for new coaches.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix React Native Web 'Unexpected text node' warning in create-service.tsx line 574 by wrapping Ionicons+Text in a View: <View style={{flexDirection:'row', gap:6, alignItems:'center'}}><Ionicons.../><Text.../></View>
OPTIONAL: Consider adding a shortcut button to create-service directly from the Profile tab (currently hidden behind Edit Profile) to improve UX discoverability for coaches
critical_code_review_comments: create-service.tsx line 574: Fragment <><Ionicons><Text></> inside TouchableOpacity causes React Native Web 'Unexpected text node' warning - wrap in View instead
Step 1 description validation only checks non-empty, not 50+ chars minimum (though score incentivizes 50+). This is a UX choice, not a bug.
Service price when price=None is correctly computed as min(package prices) - edge case: if all packages have price=0, service price=0. Valid behavior.
WeekCalendar time picker auto-calculates end time based on duration_min - works correctly (11:33 start + 60min = 12:33 end).
Score computation (85/100 when no address): 20+20+0+15+15+15 = correct
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_ services created and cleaned up during backend tests
